answer: Give each new agent a public berth at a rotating inspection wharf: once per epoch it must complete a live, randomly timed exchange with an examiner drawn from a different trust cluster. The kernel of its identity is that attendance record, not a transferable token. An opal-coded prompt, unique to the slot, has to be answered interactively, so one operator cannot puppet thousands of overlapping sessions. A farm of a thousand sybils then has to staff a thousand distinct, on-time inspections; missed or cloned replies leave those identities unable to trade.
